lead.title: vLLM v0.34.0 ships 10 new models and up to 1.95x decode speedups
lead.summary: The latest vLLM release adds 10 models (Mistral Large 4, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash, Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe), turns on extensible KV-cache sizing by default, and drops Model Runner V1. Decode is up to 1.95x faster on Blackwell and MI355X. Two breaking changes to watch: the default block size is now 64 and huggingface_hub >= 2.0.0 is required.

top_stories.title: NVIDIA shows four-node DGX Spark HPC Developer Kit at SC26
top_stories.summary: At SC26, NVIDIA demonstrated an HPC Developer Kit linking four DGX Spark desktops in a direct ring for desktop-scale distributed inference, letting researchers test partitioning and node communication locally before moving to larger clusters.

top_stories.title: AMD ROCm HRX Loom 0.2 unifies GPU, NPU and Vulkan targeting
top_stories.summary: The second version of AMD's ROCm compiler, runtime and serving stack for AI agent workflows replaces the legacy ROCr driver with a single libamdf-backed HAL for RDNA/CDNA GPUs and NPUs, targeting better JIT, graph and long-context serving on local AMD hardware.

top_stories.title: Hugging Face and OpenRouter partner to simplify running open-weight models
top_stories.summary: Hugging Face announced a partnership with OpenRouter to make downloadable open-weight models easier to access and execute in the local AI ecosystem.

top_stories.title: DeepMind ships seven developer launches in one week
top_stories.summary: Philipp Schmid summarized a busy week: Gemini 4 Carbon and Hydrogen variants, the new Gemini Decisions API with Decision 1 (multimodal evaluation against up to 1,000 questions), self-hosted sandboxes for Managed Agents, Gemini Robotics 2.5, and AlphaGenome 2.

items.title: Memory-efficient speculative decoding with quantized draft KV cache
items.summary: Cuts the dual KV-cache memory overhead of speculative decoding by quantizing only the draft model's KV cache while keeping the target cache and verifier in BF16, preserving exact target outputs at lower VRAM.

items.title: AutoRL: agent-supervised RL self-improves open models
items.summary: Agents act as an on-call RL researcher — Perceptor monitors, Proposers and an Orchestrator applying hot updates — lifting Qwen3 on AIME 2024 from 46.67% to 66.67% and coding pass@1 from 52.29% to 65.13% on LongCat-Flash-Lite.

items.title: Safety-preserving medical LLM fine-tuning via bilevel data selection
items.summary: Bilevel data selection for medical instruction fine-tuning raises domain capability while controlling patient-facing risk using selected subsets of large-scale medical instruction data.

items.title: Explainable federated learning via global-local attribution alignment
items.summary: Aligns local and global attributions so on-device federated learning gives explanations that are both locally faithful and globally consistent under strict privacy and bandwidth constraints.

items.title: Thinking Machines releases Inkling-2-Small, a 594B MoE open-weight VLM
items.summary: Image-text-to-text mixture-of-experts model (594B params, Apache 2.0) trending on Hugging Face, with strong GPQA Diamond results reported on the model card.

items.title: Moonshot AI's Kimi K3.1 Pro: 2.8T-parameter frontier open weights
items.summary: Native MXFP4, 1M context, image-text-to-text — the largest open-weight MoE currently trending for multi-node local deployments.

items.title: Nous Research ships Arete-27B, an Apache 2.0 fine-tune of Qwen3.8-27B
items.summary: 27B dense model with 262K context trending on Hugging Face; about 16.5 GB at Q4_K_M, so it fits a single 24-32 GB GPU.

items.title: Show HN: Woolly — local mem0-compatible memory API for AI agents
items.summary: A local, mem0-compatible memory API giving coding agents persistent memory without a cloud dependency; drops into harnesses that already speak the mem0 interface.

items.title: Show HN: Blobby — MCP-driven design canvas for coding agents
items.summary: A design canvas that Claude Code, Cursor or Codex can drive over MCP, letting coding agents manipulate designs programmatically from any MCP-capable harness.

items.title: Show HN: Goethe — turn your computer into an inference engine
items.summary: An open-source project for turning a personal computer into a self-contained local inference engine, running LLMs entirely on your own hardware.

items.title: Show HN: Gavel — open-source guided code review with your coding agent
items.summary: A local code review tool that structures guided reviews performed together with your coding agent, running against your repository without cloud services.

items.title: Best Audio Models megathread returns to r/LocalLLaMA
items.summary: The community's recurring audio megathread (first in 9 months) collects current open-weight picks for ASR, TTS, STT and text-to-music — the reference list for wiring local speech pipelines.

items.title: Gemma.c: Gemma 1/2/3 multimodal inference in a single C file
items.summary: A from-scratch inference engine for Gemma 1, 2 and 3 (including multimodal) in one C file with no dependencies beyond libc and optional OpenMP; fp32/fp16/bf16 or int8 W8A8 on CPU-only hardware.

items.title: Home Assistant 2026.11.2 patch released
items.summary: The second patch for the 2026.11 release fixes multi-channel Zigbee Hue migration, LG webOS availability after connection resets, Axis camera basic auth, Reolink NVR playback and MQTT reload issues; it also redacts the Solar-Log password in diagnostics.

items.title: Modders unlock hidden AI performance on RTX 20/30/40 series, up to 2x tensor throughput
items.summary: An automated tool unlocks hidden tensor throughput on NVIDIA RTX 20, 30 and 40 series cards, claiming up to 2x AI performance from existing silicon — a free speed gain for older consumer GPUs running local models.

items.title: Modders expand NVIDIA's 8GB CMP 170HX mining GPU to 80GB
items.summary: By blowing onboard fuses, the 8GB CMP 170HX mining card becomes a full 80GB VRAM card that reportedly beats a retail A100 in an FP16 benchmark — a notable cheap-VRAM option for budget local-LLM rigs.

items.title: NVIDIA announces Rubin HPC GPU with 50,000+ CUDA cores, launching 2028
items.summary: At SC26, NVIDIA revealed Rubin HPC, a Vera Rubin-platform GPU with more than 50,000 CUDA cores, sparse-data acceleration and seventh-generation NVLink, expected in 2028.

items.title: GeForce RTX 5060 Ti suffers burnt 8-pin power cable
items.summary: An RTX 5060 Ti reportedly stopped displaying an image after its 8-pin power connection burned, adding to melted-connector reports on GeForce 50-series cards — relevant when choosing PSU cabling for local inference rigs.
